source.check: returned unopposed: nominated against James J. Campbell, whose 'paper was disqualified, thus leaving Mr. Ml. Hardy returned unopposed' (page image, Newry Telegraph, 23 May 1964, p. 13); spoke at the council's annual meeting (Newry Telegraph, 13 June 1964, p. 9)

note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964 where contested. Sixteen divisions (Greencastle no longer listed); fourteen had a single candidate after withdrawals and disqualifications (Lisnacree and Dunnaman among them, Newry Telegraph, 23 May 1964, p. 13). Attical and Maghera were polled; their figures were not found, so those two divisions are not recorded. Printed 'Dunaman'; J. J. Campbell's nomination paper was disqualified. Returned unopposed.
